files.fetch_route: curl, FERC eLibrary file download API
files.what_it_shows: A statewide North Dakota overview at 1:1,700,000 with the planned Bakken East route in red over the existing WBI system in blue. The red mainline runs from the Watford City area east to Gasselton near the Minnesota line. A red lateral leaves the mainline in Barnes County just east of Jamestown, runs south through LaMoure and Dickey counties and ends at Ellendale near the South Dakota line. This is the only map found that shows the Jamestown to Ellendale lateral.
files.legible: yes, but coarse: the lateral is clear as a line, but the scale is small, so a georeference would be good to a mile or two at best

notes: The Ellendale Lateral was 81.6 miles of 20-inch pipe in the March 2026 design, starting at the mainline in Barnes County and ending at Ellendale. The March 12, 2026 overview map (page 9) shows the whole lateral and can be digitized, and the James River detail (page 685) pins down mileposts 45 to 54. The lateral was dropped after the binding open season: the April 16, 2026 updated project description has no Ellendale lateral, and on the May 7, 2026 MDU Resources call the chief financial officer said it is currently not contemplated in the design. A cancelled status is staged in update-p8327-cancelled-20261020. A route for it would be traced from the March map at low to medium accuracy, if a route is still wanted for a cancelled line. The December 2025 map is older and coarser.
